title: security: RBAC v2 KMS region pinning - audit logging and enforcement fix
author: Alex Chen
release_notes: Fixes gaps in RBAC v2 KMS region pinning enforcement and audit logging; adds residency checks and audit annotations; includes tests and a migration. Recommended for backport to 1.14.x.
description: Context: RBAC v2 introduced KMS region pinning and data residency controls, but we discovered two gaps: 1) certain code paths performed region residency checks without emitting structured audit entries, which made post-hoc compliance verification unreliable; 2) during role and key rotations the residency enforcement was bypassed for service-to-service calls under a specific load-balancer path. Motivation: close audit visibility and enforcement gaps to meet compliance SLOs and to ensure KMS residency constraints cannot be circumvented during automated role migrations. What this PR does: centralizes residency checks into a single rbac-residency service module, adds explicit structured audit annotations for every residency decision, tightens the KMS policy evaluator to fail-safe on unknown region tags, and adds a DB migration to backfill residency metadata for legacy keys. Tests: adds unit tests for the policy evaluator, integration tests exercising the residency service and KMS mock, and an e2e smoke that validates audit log entries are created for cross-region rejects. Commits summary: "centralize residency checks in rbac-residency service"; "emit structured audit annotations for residency decisions"; "tighten kms policy evaluator to fail-fast on unknown regions"; "add migration to backfill key residency metadata"; "add unit/integration/e2e tests"; "optimize residency DB query and add microbenchmarks". Files changed (high level): services/rbac-residency/* (new module, residency evaluation, annotation hooks); api/policy/kms_evaluator.go (policy enforcement tightening); audit/logging/annotator.go (structured audit entries + serializers); db/migrations/20241107_backfill_key_residency.sql; helm/redwood-private/values-residency.yaml (config knobs for region pinning default); docs/security/residency.md (explain audit signals and migration plan); tests/integration/residency_test.go; tests/e2e/residency_smoke_test.py. Notable diff snippets: added AuditAnnotation{"residency_decision":"reject","reason":"region_mismatch","key_id":"..."} at enforcement sites; updated kms_evaluator to return error on unknown region tag rather than allow fallback. Review conversation: Marcus Lee (reviewer) asked for clearer error semantics when a request is rejected; response: updated error types to include structured codes and added test coverage to assert codes; Priya Singh requested performance data for the centralized residency service under 2k rps; response: included microbenchmarks in services/rbac-residency/benchmarks and optimized a heavy JOIN into an indexed lookup, reducing median latency from 12ms to 4.5ms under simulated load; Tara O'Neill flagged a potential audit log size increase and we added sampling controls and a compression-friendly JSON structure to mitigate retention costs. CI and deployment: CI: unit & integration test suite passed; e2e initially flaky on the mock KMS auth in one run, rerun fixed it and final CI status is pass; security static analysis and linter green; deployment plan: feature gated behind residency.enabled=false by default for private installs, add a migration job to run during upgrade window, and recommend a one-week observation window before enabling on all tenants. Backport: includes a small backport patch suggested for 1.14.x to ensure customers on the release branch get audit fixes. Merge outcome: merged to main via squash on 2024-11-18 after approvals from Priya Singh and Marcus Lee. Notes: no breaking API changes, but operators should schedule the migration during a maintenance window; see docs/security/residency.md for enablement steps and migration rollback guidance.
